marketing_description: The Leviton R92 Series GFCI Outlet, model R92-GFWT1-0KW, provides 120/240V 15A GFCI protection and features a self-test function and LED test/reset indicator. This UL Listed outlet is designed for back-wire installation and has a white finish. It is suitable for use in applications requiring a NEMA 5-15R configuration.
